title: Valaida Snow
summary: She sang, played trumpet and produced shows.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Just -- wow, unbelievably inventive. Was there a regular vocalist with the band?
Who was she? I heard a lot about her, that she played trumpet, too.
She played trumpet, and sang. She also produced shows at the Grand Terrace, until Percy Venable came.
Yeah, didn't she and Earl have a personal thing going on, too?
He talks about it in the book.
They liked each other very much. But was she -- well, how good was she?
Very good. Oh, yeah, she was well-known. She was well-known around New York, and most of the country. Yeah, Valaida Snow, oh, yeah.
Wonder whatever happened to her? I'm still hearing about her in the forties, when I started getting interested in music.
I don't know whatever happened to her.
